description: This Java source file defines the 'PersonAttribute' class, representing key-value attributes associated with a Person in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for attribute type, value, and references to the Person it belongs to, along with methods for copying, comparison, hydration, and voiding attributes. The class is annotated for persistence, indexing, and caching, facilitating search and database operations.

classes.name: PersonAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute (key-value pair) associated with a person, including metadata, comparison, cloning, and hydration capabilities. Implements Comparable for ordering and integrates with Hibernate Search, Envers, and caching mechanisms for persistence and search indexing.

classes.name: PersonAttribute.DefaultComparator
classes.description: Provides a default comparator for ordering PersonAttribute instances based on type, void status, creation date, value, and ID.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of this PersonAttribute instance, excluding the personAttributeId.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helps copy the state of this attribute into another PersonAttribute instance, including metadata but excluding personAttributeId.

methods.name: equalsContent
methods.description: Compares core content fields of this attribute with another for equality, ignoring nulls on the compared attribute.

methods.name: getHydratedObject
methods.description: Attempts to instantiate or hydrate an object based on the attribute type's format and current value.

methods.name: voidAttribute
methods.description: Marks this attribute as voided, setting reason, date, and user responsible.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this attribute to another for ordering, using the default comparator.
